title: Construction and verification of an endoplasmic reticulum stress-related prognostic model for endometrial cancer based on WGCNA and machine learning algorithms.
summary: WGCNA and multiple machine-learning feature-selection algorithms produced a four-gene ER-stress prognostic model, tested on a TCGA internal split and external GEO data, with qPCR and immunofluorescence in 20 tumor/control pairs. This is a retrospective model with supporting marker experiments.
